source: ThrustCurve.org's solid motor catalog: every solid motor's record and every data file but a restricted one
selection: Every single-use and reload motor in ThrustCurve.org's catalog, in production or not, and every data file listed for one but a file its uploader restricted or one HPR Sim can't read as one motor's curve, each listed with the reason it is left out. Hybrids are left out. Each motor's names and stated figures are ThrustCurve.org's record of it, copied unchanged. Its listed figures are its default file's own: size, masses and delays from the file's header; total impulse, average and peak thrust and the NFPA 1125 burn time (between the 5%-of-peak crossings) worked out from its curve as HPR Sim flies it. The default file is one whose total impulse, average thrust and burn time are each within 1% of the record's, where one is. A motor with no file that reads lists its record's figures and can't fly.
